themes.name: Urban Scrapbook
themes.prompt: Use Image 1 as the BASE CANVAS that must stay unchanged. Place the real photographs from Image 2+ into the existing photo frame slots. Keep all decorations, borders, and frame positions exactly as shown. Keep the people as REALISTIC photographs - do NOT convert to cartoon. Apply a candid urban street photography mood: slightly desaturated colors, natural film grain, moody city atmosphere. Blend edges naturally where photo meets frame.
